decisions.reason: As a newly launched certified HVAC product that the firm has already put on its website, management is likely to continue backing it and explain any early weakness as normal market build-up.
Because the firm publicly cites a strong quality reputation and major market share in water cooling systems, this product has both visible commitment and positive justification for continued support.

Its own product page signals a relatively strong public commitment, and in an industrial machinery firm management would usually give such a recent marine product more time before considering withdrawal.
Although only mentioned rather than strongly highlighted, it is still a fresh launch in the firm's cooling portfolio, so management would more likely persist than abandon it after only one year.
A dedicated page suggests meaningful investment and strategic visibility, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within a year unlikely despite limited reported results.
Because it has its own page and appears close to the firm's technical core in heat exchanger components, management would tend to keep supporting it rather than admit failure this early.
